title: Hiring artists to color standing illustrations for 10 characters

title: Looking for 2D illustrator for corporate event project
content: [ info loker ] open project: 2d illustrator we're looking for a talented 2d illustrator to collaborate on an upcoming corporate event project! requirements: • jakarta (prio) — jabodetabek based only •experienced in 2d illustration, especially vector-based illustration. •have a distinctive illustration style and strong visual character. •proficient in adobe illustrator or other vector illustration tools. •able to translate creative briefs into engaging visual assets. •available for a project-based collaboration. •willing to wfo and commit for approximately 1 month during the event preparation period. project details: •project-based / freelance •duration: ± 1 month •corporate event project interested? send your portfolio and a brief introduction via dm! feel free to share or tag someone who might be a great fit. thank you! #infoloker #zonauang

author: 姫芽cs
title: Recruiting illustrator for character design and playmat art
content: #イラストレーター募集中 ＃イラスト ＃絵師様募集 【募集】 当姫芽cs系列のキャラクターデザインやついでにプレイマット用のイラストを描いてくれるイラストレーターを募集しております！ 特に可愛い女の子系が描ける人を大募集中です。 もちろん相談のうえ、依頼料金は支払います。 ぜひとも！
